title: Pirates of the Murder Scene
summary: A man's body is found on a boat 2 miles away from land.
method: The victim was a controlling and abusive husband who followed his wife to the lighthouse where she intended to commit suicide. He tried to attack her and she pushed him, leading to him falling from the top of the lighthouse. A friend of the victim witnessed this and helped her covering it up by putting the body on a boat and towing the man's car to the middle of a forest. The friend also sent the text from the victim's phone, to establish the alibi of the killer.
motive: The killer was fed up with the man's abuse and cheating and was planning to leave him. Because he had discovered her plans, she knew he would never let her leave him so she decided to commit suicide.
killer: The wife, and a friend hid the body
notes:
DI Mooney's last case. The decision seems sudden because he was contemplating travelling with Anna when suddenly he makes the decision to go back to England.
The beginning doesn't make sense given who the killer is. How was she so calm and able to take a nap when she just killed her husband?
